links.outcome: Model fairness across income and education subgroups
links.effect: Fairness metric suggests models perform well in terms of equality across income and education levels; AUC ranged 0.53 to 0.89 across test intervals.
links.quote: The fairness metric suggests models perform well in terms of equality.

unlisted_practices: Using ML to personalise HbA1c testing intervals for resource allocation
SHAP feature-importance explanations for model interpretation

screen.reason: Retrospective study developing and testing an ML model to optimize HbA1c test intervals in type 2 diabetes with fairness and error-risk analyses, but without evaluating a clinical deployment practice or safeguard intervention.
